4490-5292--210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4490-5292--210.description:
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink, if needed.
Gain life.
Voice of the Blessed triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 3.
4490-5292--210.notes: Additional mana and/or prerequisites may be required depending on the method used to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.

206-1456-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4694-5226-6258-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-5226-6258-7306.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

4-1170-1636-7528.notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures to cast Awaken the Ages using convoke without paying mana.
4-1170-1636-7528.description:
Cast Awaken the Ages using Hoarding Broodlord's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Strife Scholar.
When Strife Scholar enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

3375-4399-4518-6823.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Aunt May trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Aunt May trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4399-4518-6823.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1621-1895-6867-7183.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1263-4871-5256-6887.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-4478-5477-5660-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2366-5434-5702-7288.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5434-5702-7288.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1169-1308-1563-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2448-5220-6900-7286.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2448-5220-6900-7286.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

413-4605-4681-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {5}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Karmic Guide and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it, Blasting Station and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
If you returned a creature in step 4, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it
Resolve the Karmic Guide token's trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2440-3581-4068-7109.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2440-3581-4068-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-3581-4068-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

2034-3912-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Khalni Garden.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Khalni Garden.
When Khalni Garden dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Khalni Garden enters, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token.
Repeat.

454-1978-3043.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with defender.
454-1978-3043.description:
Cause Axebane Guardian to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Axebane Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

7-6867-6884.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures excluding Aang that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-6867-6884.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

1456-5051-5078-6006.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1671-4826-5451-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
1671-4826-5451-5702.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters untapped due to Archelos, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

2034-3641-4593-6705.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-3641-4593-6705.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

719-1486-1719-1753.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
719-1486-1719-1753.description:
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat.
719-1486-1719-1753.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

2719-3774-6220.easyPrerequisites: Luxior, Giada's Gift attached to Chandra.
2719-3774-6220.description:
Activate Chandra's second loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate the token's second loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, creating a token copy of the Chandra with Luxior attached.
Repeat step 2.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

1887-3305-4022-5231-5926.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Body Launderer, adding {R}.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating a token copy of each creature card in your graveyard that is a 1/1 Insect.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, the Hidden Herbalist token triggers once and the Grist, Voracious Larva token triggers for each token created this way.
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the Hidden Herbalist trigger, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

168-372-1917.description:
Cast Touch the Spirit Realm by paying {2}{W}.
When Touch the Spirit Realm enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Touch the Spirit Realm leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Oblivion Ring to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Oblivion Ring enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Touch the Spirit Realm.
Touch the Spirit Realm leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Oblivion Ring and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Oblivion Ring leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Touch the Spirit Realm to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

376-678-3771-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional non-Human creature.
Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
376-678-3771-4050.description:
Cast Cubwarden for its mutate cost by paying {W}{W}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Resolve Cubwarden, targeting a non-Human creature you control.
The Cubwarden mutated creature triggers, creating two 1/1 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Cubwarden mutated creature, adding {W}.
When the Cubwarden mutated creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Cubwarden and any cards merged with it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Cat token, adding {W}.
Repeat.

971-4498-5017.notablePrerequisites:
Pentad Prism has at least one charge counter.
Urban Daggertooth has at least one +1/+1 counter.
You have the highest life total.
971-4498-5017.description:
Activate Pestilence by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Urban Daggertooth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Urban Daggertooth and a charge counter on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism's ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2034-2577-4720.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
